items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: just like I told him when John Bruce would come home or pick his daddy, play this, play this. I said I can't play that, but you're going to try to play it.

ctx.x: I don't think I practiced over an hour myself. I was on the clarinet, yeah. Had to practice on the clarinet, just like I told him when John Bruce would come home or pick his daddy, play this, play this. I said I can't play that, but you're going to try to play it. My mother would tell him, don't hurt that boy, he's going to play it. I learned how to play his piano, didn't I? Yeah, he would punch you. Nothing make out of it, he'd punch you. And he was a half way of price for that too, he was called Slap Room…
Well that's right, yeah. I think I told him that. Yeah, yeah, I remember that. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
